description: Per-period fundamentals series for a ticker from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts: one row per reported period with revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, total assets, total liabilities and shares outstanding, values exactly as filed; a concept absent for a period is null. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/screener/fundamentals/{ticker}.

periods.description: Number of reported periods, default 8, cap 20

name: screener_fundamentals
